(Currently Amended) 1. A method for preparing a cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix comprising: i) removing the epidermis from allograft skin; ii) decellularizing the dermis by removing cells in the dermis; iii) mixing glycerol and a basic solution selected from a buffer solution and an animal cell culture medium; iv) dissolving sucrose in the mixed solution to a final concentration of 20 to 40% by weight to obtain a cryoprotectant; v) penetrating the cryoprotectant into the skin from which the epidermis and dermal cells are removed; vi) freezing the cryoprotectant-penetrated skin in a controlled rate freezer; and vii) recovering the cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix.

(Currently Amended) 8. An autograft substitute comprising the cryopreserved acellular dermal matrix prepared by the method according to any one of claims 1 to 7.
